summary: Hydro One Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on October 8, 2026, disclosing a news release dated October 7, 2026. The filing announces that Hydro One Networks Inc. submitted its 2028-2032 Joint Rate Application to the Ontario Energy Board, outlining an approximately $37 billion five-year investment plan for transmission and distribution infrastructure. The plan targets adding 6,000 MW of new capacity, modernizing 1,400 km of transmission lines, replacing 85,000 poles, and deploying smart grid and energy storage technologies. This is a routine regulatory rate application and capital plan filing, not a special situation. Watch for OEB approval outcomes and rate impact decisions.
